segments.name: Residential
segments.description: Makes residential roofing accessories, rain-carrying products, ventilation and mail systems sold to home improvement retailers, wholesalers and contractors.
segments.evidence: Residential Segment Trim, coil and flashings, sofit, fascia, other accessories Roof integrity

segments.name: Agtech
segments.description: Designs, engineers and builds greenhouses and controlled environment agriculture structures for growers, retailers and institutions.
segments.evidence: Agtech Segment Controlled environmental agriculture, and custom greenhouse solutions including the designing, engineering, manufacturing, full scope construction of structures and integration of subsystems

segments.name: Infrastructure
segments.description: Provides engineered solutions for bridges, highways and airfields, including bearings, expansion joints and pavement seals, to contractors.
segments.evidence: Infrastructure Segment Engineered solutions for bridges, highways and airfields, including structural bearings, expansion joints, pavement seals, elastomeric concrete, bridge cable protection systems

revenueModel.text: Contractors, home improvement retailers, wholesalers and growers pay Gibraltar for building products, greenhouse structures and engineered infrastructure solutions.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company serves customers primarily in the U.S. and Canada including home improvement retailers, wholesalers, distributors, contractors

changes.text: In 2026 Gibraltar acquired OmniMax, which will be reported in the Residential segment.
changes.evidence: OmniMax will be reported as part of the Company's Residential segment.
